title: Hardware wallet sales in Russia more than double as new crypto rules near
summary: Wildberries’ average price for hardware wallets fell 13% to 7,900 rubles, and M.Video broadened its range of products, though neither retailer identified the driving force behind the renewed demand.

title: Brazil's central bank orders exchanges to delay large crypto transfers abroad
summary: The rule applies to transfers above $10,000 and smaller transactions flagged as risky by exchanges.

title: Trillions in institutional money to flow into bitcoin, says Bitwise's Matt Hougan
summary: The digital asset manager's CIO says large capital pools control up to $200 trillion globally, and just a 1% shift toward bitcoin could unlock massive long-term growth.

title: Why trillion-dollar asset manager T. Rowe Price put memecoins in its crypto ETF
summary: The $1.9 trillion asset manager says excluding established memecoins on principle would undermine its active approach to crypto investing.

title: U.S. Senate opens first stage of crypto Clarity Act voting to give bill a chance next month
summary: The majority leader opened the multi-stage process the Senate follows when trying to get a bill over its 60-vote hurdle, so it's still got a shot in September.
